download_msc3B_model: download the MSC 3B 1024 truncated model to the specified datapath directory
build_msc3B_model: build the MSC 3B 1024 model by downloading model_v0.1.tar.gz if not already built
check_msc3B_built: check if the MSC 3B 1024 model version v0.1 is already built in the data directory
get_msc3B_model_dir: get the model directory path for the MSC 3B 1024 model under the msc subfolder
review_download_function: review the download function that handles MSC 3B model download with version checking
